BITPOINT 暗号資産レンディング
summary: Active crypto-asset lending service launched by BITPOINT on 2020-11-26. Customers lend crypto assets under a consumption-loan contract and receive equivalent crypto plus a contractual lending fee under the published terms.
what_happened: BITPOINT announced the launch of its crypto-asset lending service on 2020-11-26. Current first-party materials describe a consumption-loan contract in which customers lend crypto assets to BITPOINT, with lending periods and lending-fee rates fixed per offering. The current service detail states that equivalent crypto and the lending fee are returned on the day after the lending period ends and that mid-term cancellation is unavailable. BITPOINT explicitly states that the service is not a crypto-asset exchange service under the Payment Services Act and that assets lent through the service are not subject to statutory segregated management. The product is also stated not to be a deposit-like product or deposit-insurance covered.
uncertainty_notes: Published launch/current lending rates are issuer product terms, not independently verified realized returns. Current return mechanics do not establish universal historical repayment performance. Exchange-service custody protections must not be generalized to lent balances.
notes: Promoted in Phase 10 from duplicate-clear candidate cya_candidate_000133 after candidate-only PR #273 passed the hardened exact-head scanner against the 114-platform canonical corpus.
